_comment: Design tokens for the demo. Two palettes deliberately: the logo's own colours vs the brand colours the client documented. Flip `theme.mode` to switch the whole app.

brand._note: Yellow + black, taken from the client's written brief (containers painted black and yellow). This is what the client described their brand as.

logo._note: Colours actually extracted from the supplied logo file (cream / tan / brown / deep red). Warmer, food-photography feel. Does NOT match the documented yellow-and-black brand - here because the client's file analyses this way.

typography._note: Bold heavy sans per the brand brief. Falls back to system fonts - no external font loading, so it works offline and costs nothing.

shape._note: Container branding is boxy - sharp-ish corners, not pill-shaped.
